messages:
Samir: Quick runtime open mic right after the roadmap. Throw short Qs about batching, caching, kernels, or rollout sequencing and we'll triage live. I'll pull Diego in for kernel details.

Jess: Noticed 99.9p latency tail on <1s requests during peak. Are we prioritizing kernel micro-ops or better request scheduling first?

Diego: Both are on the plan. For short sync requests there's a kernel micro-optimization (reduces per-call overhead) targeted for Q2. For burst-induced tails we want smarter scheduling + prewarmed warm pools in Dedicated. We'll share bench numbers after initial canaries.

Priya: Does the kernel change block any customer upgrades for Dedicated? Need to coordinate with renewals.

Diego: No blocking. It'll be feature-flagged and opt-in for early canaries. Fallback to current kernel exists so rollouts are safe.

Maya: Customers report big cold-cache spikes after autoscale events. Any plans for KV cache warm-rehydration?

Liam: We're experimenting with a lightweight prewarm that rehydrates top prefixes when a new instance joins. In synthetic traces it cuts cold-miss rate ~60%. We need to test with real traffic shapes first.

Jess: Can we expose a control so customers choose prewarm aggressiveness? Some customers prefer lower cost over lower tail latency.

Samir: Yes — per-deployment toggle: prewarm=aggressive|balanced|off. Default balanced for Dedicated; hosted defaults balanced but can be opted-out.

Annie: ETA on the adaptive batcher that adjusts batch size based on seq-length distribution? Multi-tenant workloads would benefit.

Diego: Alpha is in internal QA this week. Beta planned next month. It uses a lightweight seq-hist estimator and grows batch sizes where safe. We'll measure cost delta and SLO impact before wider rollout.

Priya: Will adaptive batching interact poorly with KV cache heuristics? Worried about prefix locality mixing across tenants.

Diego: Alpha enforces tenant-aware batching and shard affinity for KV keys. No cross-tenant mixing unless explicitly enabled in config.

Liam: Ops request: schedule a 1h low-traffic smoke window (weekday early AM) when we first flip adaptive in Dedicated. Ops, please coordinate.

Samir: Agreed. Ops, aim for a 03:00 weekday window for canary smoke tests. We'll publish a checklist in #eng-runtime.

Annie: Are quantized kernels for smaller models (embeddings-heavy) on the roadmap? Could drop cost for those workloads.

Diego: Yes — 8-bit kernels planned with per-model quality checks and cert matrix. Wide beta targeted for Q3.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started runtime-kernel-microopt-v1 -> 2145010033 by Diego at 2145010050 :rocket:

Maya: Can leadership post a concise customer-facing summary of rollout flags and knobs after the session? CS needs a short explainer they can share.

Samir: I'll write a 1-2 pager with rollout timelines, feature flags, and recommended customer settings. Expect it by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Jess: Thanks, everyone — super helpful.
